Per the migration guide, extra metadata belongs in json_schema_extra. Field(..., cli=...) becomes Field(..., json_schema_extra={\"cli\": ...}), which stores the same key/value in field_info.json_schema_extra. This is the failure reported at line 37."}, {"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_custom_and_setup_log.py:38:field-cli-extra"], "search": "    max_records: int = Field(10, cli=(\"-m\", \"--max-records\"))", "replace": "    max_records: int = Field(10, json_schema_extra={\"cli\": (\"-m\", \"--max-records\")})", "explanation": "Same deprecated Field() extra-keyword pattern on max_records. Moved the 'cli' key into json_schema_extra per the Pydantic V2 migration guide so the CLI option metadata is preserved without the deprecation warning."}], "notes": "The previous Config-to-model_config migration (original finding :28:config-class) is correct and is left unchanged. The validation failure comes from the two Field(..., cli=...) calls on input_file and max_records, which Pydantic V2 deprecates. Both are moved to json_schema_extra with the same value. No finding id was supplied for these Field lines, so I used descriptive ids. The pydantic_cli core reads the 'cli' metadata, so it must also read it from field_info.json_schema_extra. That is outside this file and was not checked here; if core.py still reads field_info.extra, it will need the same change. Imports are unchanged because Field and ConfigDict are still used."}
